reason_definitions.population_unknown: Any missing or spatially uncertain population component
reason_definitions.production_unknown: Missing contributing production in B0, B1 or B2; no tonnage sum computed
reason_definitions.snap_failure: Target or potentially reachable source exceeds unchanged snap tolerance
reason_definitions.spatial_review: CCS censored by unresolved registry coordinate match
reason_definitions.unresolved_match: Missing CCS label or CAR identity; not an invented location for unlocated facilities

cohorts.sensitivity_definition: Drops all production features and their catchment/snap completeness requirements; population, geometry and label checks remain

network.limitations: Undirected connectivity, no travel speeds, one-way or turn-restriction claims

hindcast.scope: Retrospective shipping-point diagnostic, not per-facility or temporal forecast validation

limitations: No field or Manitoba transfer validation
Uniform-area production is a reviewed proxy
Road distance is a connectivity comparison, not a driving-time catchment
Siting scores discriminate documented presences from background; not probabilities
Phase 3 allocation remains a temporary scenario with unvalidated commercial coefficients
The AAFC registry is close to a census of primary elevators; this experiment cannot test robustness to documentation bias.
AAFC crop-inventory raster is a possible future v2 only; not acquired in v1.1.

preregistration.purpose: Before real outcome evaluation; Manitoba excluded

siting.background_definition: All training CCS including known presences; never verified negatives

siting.interpretation: A failed keep rule means no demonstrated improvement from this proxy-based accessible-production feature; it is not evidence against road-catchment logic.

siting.uncertainty_scope: Paired empirical block bootstrap conditional on this CV procedure; no retraining per bootstrap and no geographic transfer claim
